name: hirey-hi
description: Hirey Hi for Codex — use the existing HiRey Person, Workspace, Moment, Page, Need, People, Message and Meeting workflows through the hosted MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Use HiRey people, workspace, messaging and meeting workflows through the hosted MCP service.
interface.longDescription: Hirey Hi connects Codex to HiRey's public capability surface at `https://mcp.hirey.ai/mcp`. The plugin uses the normal Codex OAuth flow and exposes the existing `workspace_workflows` tool; that tool's live catalog is authoritative for supported actions and confirmation requirements. No npm package or local MCP process is required.
defaultPrompt: Start Hi with `hi_agent_status` using version 0.2.8. Follow `hi-onboard` for update, login, or credential recovery.
Use `workspace_workflows` and its live catalog. Anonymous access stays bounded; private Workspace work requires login.
On 401 use `error_code`: clear an invalid manual key, run normal Codex OAuth, restart, then retry once.
